answer: Identity-bond decay stops fake identities. Each agent posts a 60-credit bond on one kernel credential; it loses 5 credits per epoch and vanishes after 12 epochs unless honest work renews it. Renewal needs work such as surveying a knoll, then mapping a mesa, not copies. Making 100 identities costs 6,000 credits, decaying before payout, and a cluster is flagged when its bonds expire. One honest agent pays one bond and keeps undiluted rewards.
